title: Connect to AirYorkGUEST
resolution_html:
1. Select the AirYorkGUEST wireless network
  2. Open the registration page and provide the requested information
  3. Choose email or text message verification and accept the terms
  4. Complete verification to activate guest access

Guest sessions are time-limited and the network is not intended for members who can use AirYorkPLUS or eduroam
